<div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-6 col-lg-4 text-center valign-middle">
<div itemscope="" itemtype="https://schema.org/Person">
<h1 itemprop="name">Stephen Wiltshire</h1>
            Stephen Wiltshire is an <span itemprop="jobTitle">artist</span> who draws detailed cityscapes. He has a particular talent for drawing lifelike, accurate depictions of cities, skylines and street scenes sometimes after having only observed them briefly. He was awarded Member of the Order of the British Empire for services to the art world in 2006. His drawings are popular all over the world, and is held in a number of important art collections and museums. 
            <br/><br/>
